note: Two styles. 'paraphrase': questions an investigator might ask, written in my own words after reading the passages. 'terms': keyword-heavy queries of the kind the agent itself writes when it calls searchRegulations. Every passage that answers a question is listed. Authored by the same person who built the chunker, so treat scores as a regression baseline, not an unbiased benchmark.
